title: Browser security header baseline
description: Single source of truth for every HTTP security header the production server emits (issue #113). `make security-headers-generate` renders serve.json from it, the container entrypoint extends the CSP connect-src from it at start-up, `make lint-security-headers` fails when serve.json drifts from it, and `make check-security-headers` asserts the running production image emits it.

document.description: Headers that govern a document — the Content-Security-Policy is emitted with them. `source` is the serve-handler glob for the HTML shell; every SPA route resolves to it.

response.description: Headers emitted on every response, hashed assets included. `**` is every response.

directives.description: CSP directive name to its ordered source list. Serialized in this order.

connectSrcFromEnv.description: Environment variables whose URL origins are appended to connect-src: `build` at generation time from the dotenv files, `runtime` at container start from the process environment.

cacheControl.description: Cache-Control rules, one per serve-handler source glob, preserved verbatim in serve.json.

headers.description: Static headers emitted verbatim, in this order.
